svg.text: mcring v1 — sheet 5/5: Outputs + Connectors: WS2812 (gated), piezo, aux MOSFET, MAX98357A speaker amp (gated, optional)
net-label schematic generated by hardware/electrical/schematic_svg.py from mcring_v1.py — 22 parts on this sheet
grey pin numbers are to be VERIFIED against the datasheets; red = power net, green = GND, blue = signal, x = NC, grey 'spare' = free GPIO; dashed grey box + * = off-board part wired to the board
• WS2812B-2020 powered from 3V3 through U9 (TPS22916, ON = IO33): ~0.6-1 mA idle otherwise.
• Data from IO43 through 1 kOhm (limits the boot-chatter back-feed while VLED is off); 100 nF + 1 uF at the LED.
• Piezo: IO4 -> 100 Ohm -> BZ1 wire pads; the 9x9 element PZ1 is off-board and optional (DNP until the enclosure has a pocket).
• Q1 AO3400 low-side switch from IO9 (100k pull-down): aux pads = VBAT + open drain.

• OPTIONAL speaker (fit U10/U11/C25/C26/R20-R24/LS1 together): 3V3 -> U11 TPS22916 (ON = IO34 AMP_PWR_EN, 100k pull-down) -> VAMP -> U10 MAX98357A VDD (10 uF + 100 nF); the amp draws nothing while U11 is open.
• I2S: BCLK IO35, LRCLK IO36, DIN IO37 (512 kHz / 16 kHz, no MCLK), each through R22/R23/R24 1k: bounds the ESD-diode back-feed into the unpowered amp to <= 2.6 mA per pin while VAMP is off.
• SD_MODE tied to VAMP = left-channel mode (> 1.4 V; the firmware duplicates mono into both slots). Firmware must still park

• IO35-37 low while AMP_PWR_EN is low (a pin left high is a mA-class drain, not damage). GAIN_SLOT -> R21 100k -> VAMP = 3 dB (0 dBFS = 1.4 Vrms = 0.25 W into 8 Ohm, inside the speaker's 300 mW rating); R21 0R = 6 dB (0.5 W = speaker max, bench option),
• DNP = 9 dB (clips at 3.3 V). TQFN pin table, SD/gain thresholds and the digital-input abs-max rating VERIFY (README §6 17-19).
• OUTP/OUTN -> SPK1 wire pads (0.3 mm pair) -> LS1 PUI AS01008MR-2-R 10 mm 8 Ohm (off-board, enclosure speaker pocket).
